other_conditions: Applicant should not be a beneficiary under any other Social Security pension scheme
Applicant or their spouse should not be retired or permanently employed in Central or State Government or in public sector undertakings
Applicant or their spouse should not be a recipient of any Government pension from Central or State Government or public sector undertakings
Applicant’s family is not an income tax payee
Applicant must possess a Voter ID card and an Aadhar Card
benefits_summary: ₹1,000 per month transferred directly to the beneficiary’s bank account.
